**Guard conditions:**
- this+0x40 (profile page control) must yield non-null from GetControl(3) → PASS; null → skip entirely
- strlen(byte_7CD818) == 0 (empty player name) → BLOCKED (falls to error path)
- PlayerNameNeverUsedProfileNameUniquenessCheck fails → BLOCKED (error path: display "Profile Already Exists", dispatch prompt)
- byte_7D2E41 (season scoring flag) non-zero → triggers directory path construction and sub_499690 path creation (then clears flag)
- TextFileReader(&byte_7CD818) != -1 → profile file EXISTS, sets v2=0 (success)
- v3[276] (profile list count) > 0 → triggers sub_4B0770 UI refresh
- If profile name is valid and file exists → returns 0 (success)
- If profile name validation fails or control is null → returns -1 (failure)
